questions.prompt: How many points per game did Tim Duncan average in the 1999 Finals?
questions.note: 27.4 points per game while winning Finals MVP.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: while averaging 27.4 points and fourteen rebounds with 2.4 assists and 2.2 blocks in the Finals

funFacts.text: Duncan was in his second NBA season alongside David Robinson in the Twin Towers pairing.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 1998–99 season was the second season of the "Twin Towers" pairing

funFacts.text: San Antonio drafted Duncan after an injury-hit season and a fortunate draft lottery.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs earned this draft pick through the draft lottery due to a 62-loss 1996–97 season

funFacts.text: The Knicks were an eighth seed when they reached the Finals, an extraordinary playoff run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Knicks barely qualified for the playoffs and received the eighth and final seed

questions.prompt: Manute Bol set the record for blocks in a quarter in December 1985. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 8 blocks in the first quarter, setting the NBA record, and 11 blocks in the first half, tying the NBA record

funFacts.text: Bol set his mark while playing for Washington in an overtime victory against the Milwaukee Bucks.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Washington Bullets  | December 12, 1985  | Milwaukee Bucks

funFacts.text: The rookie also reached a huge first-half swat total in the same game against Milwaukee.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 11 blocks in the first half, tying the NBA record

funFacts.text: Bol later repeated the feat in a fourth quarter against Indiana during his Washington years.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 8 blocks in the fourth quarter, tying the NBA record
